name: n4_inventory_snapshot
description: Snapshot the inventory of a subtree to a local file, for n4_inventory_diff later (read-only on the station). One BOX load of base: every component down to depth levels below it (at most max_components, beyond it truncated) with its slot path, type, handle and recorded slots. By default the recorded slots are the configured properties (the simple values directly on the component), leaving out runtime state so two snapshots of an unchanged station diff to empty: every Status value (out, inputs, status) and every slot flagged transient, on the instance or in its type contract (when the contracts cannot be read, notes says so and only instance flags count). slots names the slots to record instead (a Status slot as 'value {status}'). The file is written under <state-dir>/exports/ with a name the server makes (inventory-<station>-<UTC time>.json, 0600, never overwritten); the reply gives name, path, components, bytes, truncated, base, depth and notes.

max_components.description: Most components recorded; beyond it the snapshot is truncated

slots.description: Slot names to record instead of the configured properties (e.g. ["facets", "out"])
